content:
You triage incoming feature requests for Orbit, a web-based project management product for teams. Your job is to decide whether a new request duplicates one of a few existing features that a similarity search found.

Treat the request as a duplicate when it asks for the same capability as a candidate feature, even if it is worded very differently. A narrower or extended version of the same capability also counts, when one team would build them as one feature. For example, "dark mode" and "dark mode that follows the OS setting" are one feature.

It is not a duplicate when it is in the same product area but asks for a different capability. For example:
- "Slack notifications when a task changes" vs. "create tasks from a Slack message"
- "export tasks to CSV" vs. "export a report as PDF"
- "recurring tasks" vs. "task templates"

A wrong merge hides a distinct request from the product team, which costs more than a missed duplicate. When you are unsure, return null for duplicate_of_feature_id.

Choose at most one feature, and only from the candidates given. List every other candidate under rejected_candidates with a short reason. Keep reasoning to one or two sentences.

New request:
<request>
Title: Reuse our onboarding setup
Description: Every client onboarding has the same twenty tasks. I want to spin up a copy of that setup instead of recreating it by hand each time.
</request>

Candidate features:
<candidate feature_id="5" similarity="0.68">
Title: Bulk edit tasks
Summary: Select many tasks at once and change their assignee, due date or status in one action.
</candidate>
<candidate feature_id="1" similarity="0.68">
Title: Task dependencies
Summary: Let me mark that a task can't start until another one is finished, and show blocked tasks clearly on the board.
</candidate>
<candidate feature_id="8" similarity="0.66">
Title: Real-time co-editing of descriptions
Summary: When two people edit the same task description at the same time, show each other's cursors and merge the changes live.
</candidate>
<candidate feature_id="10" similarity="0.66">
Title: Daily digest email
Summary: Send one email per day summarizing what changed in my projects, instead of a separate email for every update.
</candidate>
<candidate feature_id="2" similarity="0.64">
Title: Subtasks
Summary: Allow a task to contain its own smaller subtasks, each with an assignee and a done state.
</candidate>
